Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support further upside.

Silver.note: Strong industrial demand and gold sympathy drive outperformance.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and green energy transition underpin demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit from mine closures offsets short-term flat pricing.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Surplus Indonesian supply growth outpaces sluggish stainless steel demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charges at record lows highlight severe concentrate tightness.

Iron Ore.note: Persistent weakness in Chinese real estate construction continues to cap demand.

Coal.note: Balanced seaborne market with offsetting Asian demand and high global inventories.

Rare Earths.note: Oversupply from China and shifting EV motor technologies dampen near-term pricing.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production demand balances ample South African and Gabonese supply.

PGM.note: Weak auto catalytic demand and rising recycling volumes weigh on pricing.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural application rates offset normalized supply chains.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary supply and strong solar demand offset weak traditional construction.

Diversified.note: Balanced portfolio exposure offsets iron ore weakness with copper and gold strength.
